page.overview:
Who is Dirkson D'Agostino?

Dirkson D'Agostino is a minor character in Cars and Cars 3. He is a black and green Capital Motors. He races for the sponsor Trunk Fresh.

Dirkson used to work in graphics for a small racing outfit.

"Dirkson D'Agostino discovered his natural racing talent while working in the graphics department for a small racing outfit. Running errands between buildings, he dodged all kinds of obstacles at insane speeds. One day Dirkson caught the eye of the race shop's owner, who fired the young upstart for what he considered reckless driving in the workplace, and rehired him as one of his pro racers, for what he considered a natural talent on the race track."

Dirkson D'Agostino appears in Cars: The Video Game, with the name Buck. In Palm Mile Speedway, he finished in 10th place; in Motor Speedway of the South, he finished in 10th place; in Sun Valley International Speedway, he finished in 10th place; in Smasherville International Speedway, he finished in 10th place and in Los Angeles International Speedway, he finished in 10th place.
